title: The Stream – Activity Log & Audit Trail plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Stream – Activity Log & Audit Trail plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'group-name' parameter. This affects all versions up to and including 4.5.0. The flaw allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. Exploitation requires BuddyPress with its Groups component enabled and default group-creation permissions, allowing any logged-in member to create groups.
